scope: Current production obi_v1 path used by rdp-sm-run; source audit, no live API calls
counting_unit: Logical complete reads; assumes single-page collections, successful ordinary ACK flow, warm SDK version cache. HTTP pagination, retries and background readers are additional.
ordinary_successful_new_window: 9 + 4*N; N is current Session known-ID count including current ACK order; excludes background, retries, extra main-loop iterations, startup, final close and merge

conditional_extra_reads.unproved_known_ids_before_snapshot: 1 order + 1 complete market trade read per unproved ID
conditional_extra_reads.strict_canceled_submission_proof_refresh: 1 complete open-order collection + 1 complete market trade collection, shared across all candidates
conditional_extra_reads.strict_canceled_submission_proof_in_clos: 1 complete open-order collection + 1 complete market trade collection per qualifying candidate
conditional_extra_reads.unknown_intent_close_lookup: 1 complete open-order collection per close round if any placement is UNKNOWN or INTENT
conditional_extra_reads.external_disappeared_order: up to 2 order details + 1 complete trade collection per eligible external ID
conditional_extra_reads.pending_confirmations: sleep up to 2s then another full close round over all known IDs; no cancel=True from this waiter
conditional_extra_reads.ws_tick_unverified: 2 tick reads; independent of the 2 reads for a later new preparation
conditional_extra_reads.inventory_mismatch_waiter: 1 extra server-time read, sleep up to 1s, then next loop restarts snapshot
conditional_extra_reads.pagination_recovery: restarts each failed collection/filter scope from page one, then normal reads still run
conditional_extra_reads.sdk_version: cold cache: 1 /version read; ordinary repeated resolver calls use local cache
conditional_extra_reads.final_close: one extra complete close round over all known IDs; exception recovery may also close again
conditional_extra_reads.eligible_successful_merge: two extra full close rounds, 8*N single-page reads, plus settlement metadata/on-chain/relayer queries; final merge check also reads server time when elapsed is omitted

background.legacy_time_warmer: 1 /time per iteration, followed by 0.5s sleep; start-to-start includes HTTP duration
background.new_sync_orders: 3 + K single-page GETs per target 1s round; K<=4 selected observed pending order IDs
background.new_sync_startup: 1 derive-api-key GET and 1 initial /time read per companion
background.new_sync_steady_state: approximately 4 + average(K) GET/s with single pages and target periods sustained; not included in phase formulas

startup.discovery: 1 /time + 1 Gamma market read, plus /time waits if before T15
startup.first_healthy_preflight: 1 market + 1 derive + 2 initial tick + 1 positions + 1 open orders + 1 balance + 1 trades + 1 cold /version + 1 /time = 10 reads
startup.executor_open_healthy_preflight: same 8 reads without repeated initial ticks, reuses ready feed
startup.executor_client_connect: 1 additional derive GET; cold version occurs at first runtime account read
startup.healthy_minimum_before_runtime_loop: 21 single-page reads when discovery starts after T15, no current-market recovery fence, no tick revalidation or retry
startup.current_market_recovery: per candidate detail lookup plus market trades and cancellation; only exceptional restart path

limitations: call_sites.csv is a syntax index including conditionals, helpers and legacy branches; its row count is not a count of HTTP requests.
No claims of measured latency, request rate improvement or whole-market fixed request count are made.
Only current obi_v1 path is counted in formulas; legacy execute_window and non-OBI book REST are indexed but excluded.
